keep_inline_images_in naming 'a' keeps an image inside a link that also holds a block element

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions

def main() -> None:
    html = '<a href="https://example.com/file.pdf"><img src="pdf.png"><p>Download PDF</p></a>'
    options = ConversionOptions(keep_inline_images_in=["a"])
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
